purpose: INTERNAL A/B mechanism cases only; official comparisons require unmodified dev cohort via run_dev.py.
selection_reason: closest available gate/band mix; prefer long hidden biomaster prefixes (F31)
band_basis: p95 = exact cohort gate_p95_alignment.full; p50/p80/p90/p99 = weighted dev proxies (clamped around p95); population cutoffs unavailable

composition_alignment_measured.metric: effect size（下一版主门口径；本轮仅记录，不作门）
composition_alignment_measured.gate_bands: 各门按人口 uncached_expected 的 p50/p80/p90/p95/p99 分 6 档

turn_start.note: n=20 低于构成检验的可用规模，不可评估

composition_alignment_measured.note: rho(p95 比) 在档边界会剧烈跳动（人口 intra p95=11,740 恰为档 3 上边界），不能作对齐指标；应改用本节的档占比效应量。

availability_limits.note: 722 shipped requests are source-chain prefixes; longer chains.jsonl counts do not supply additional requests. No duplicate/stitch/synthetic requests.

prediction.limitations: current length-340 role guess; adjacent LCP ancestry only; no token path equality, old-branch resurrection, decode, eviction, timing; not F24 reproduction
